# The Guardian

> > The Guardian is a leading British news organization offering independent journalism, in-depth reporting, and a comprehensive job search platform across the UK.

The Guardian provides breaking news, political coverage, and editorial content while operating Guardian Jobs, a major UK employment portal serving cities including London, Manchester, Birmingham, Edinburgh, and beyond. Users can access news alerts through newsletter subscriptions and explore career opportunities across multiple sectors.

## Key Topics

- Guardian Jobs
- UK employment and job search
- Breaking news and politics
- Newsletter subscriptions
- London, Manchester, Birmingham, Edinburgh
- Career portal and job listings
- Email alerts and news updates
- Independent journalism
- Sector-based job browsing
- Editorial content
- UK cities employment (Leeds, Bristol, Liverpool, Glasgow, Cardiff)
- CV submission and career search
- Job board filtering
- Regional job markets

## Job Search & Employment

- [Job search | Find your dream job with Guardian Jobs](https://jobs.theguardian.com/?INTCMP=JB2): Guardian Jobs homepage for UK career search and CV submission
- [Find a job - Find great jobs on Guardian Jobs](https://jobs.theguardian.com/jobs/?CMP=PPC_JOBS_GGL_): Guardian Jobs main search page for UK employment across sectors

## Newsletters & Subscriptions

- [Guardian newsletters: Sign up for our free newsletters](https://register.theguardian.com/): Newsletter signup page for Guardian email subscriptions and news alerts
